items.description: Talk to cute waifu on Desktop (Windows/Mac/Linux). Waifus are anime-themed personal assistants.
Talk to cute waifu on Android. Waifus are anime-themed personal assistants.

Mesibo is a real-time chat app for your business or personal communication and also provides APIs that lets you build real-time chat messaging, voice, and video calls in your mobile apps and websites in just a few hours. Mesibo SDK underpins the complexities of messaging not only by providing a cross-platform API, ready to use UI but also a solid, scalable carrier-grade platform built from the ground-up to support millions of concurrent calls & messaging with low latency & high reliability.
Detective is a chat game where the player gets randomly paired with either another player or an automated chat bot. This application uses the BOT Libre API.

Developers can use this this mashup to insert a Giphy search bot into their HipChat sessions. Whenever a user types /giphy plus a keyword, the Lucille HipChat Bot will return a Gif that matches the search criteria. Requirements for implementation include the Python HipChat Library.
The Hipchat and Plivo API mashup â€” an IVR system that use's HipChat APIs and post details of incoming calls, recordings and voicemails on your Plivo number to HipChat.
Morces is a mobile web platform that put businesses on mobile.
Social Butterfly allows you to anonymously chat with random strangers through Google Talk. If you use Gmail, you already have Google Talk.
An easy way to add live chat support to any website, leveraging public chat protocols (via the tropo API) and the Campfire chat room.
Down or Not checks a website from 3 locations in the WatchMouse network and decides if a site is indeed down or not.

OggChat is a live chat solution for website support and sales that integrates with Google Talk and GMail. It incorporates features such as custom chat windows and skills based routing, but routes all chats directly to each operator's Google Talk acc
Flash-based interface to Google Talk. Allows you to chat without a client install. Gtalkr also has its own API.
A Google Gadget that lets you search the Rhapsody catalog of millions of songs by their lyrics. You can also use it to find YouTube and Yahoo videos.
Displays all Formula One Grand Prix Circuits raced from 1950 to 2007.
A time tracking solution that integrates with online project collaboration software including Basecamp and Blinksale.
If you are interested in the game business, you can use the GCDB searching and mapping tools to find companies near you.
User driven search where users contribute listings, reviews, pictures, tags, and more. Toronto is first city setup, includes mapped traffic conditions.
GoOffCampus.com is a resource intended to help students find rental properties close to campuses all over the US.
Synchronize Microsoft Outlook and Google Calendar with this Windows utility. Requires .Net 2.0 and Outlook 2003 or higher.
The Internet TV charts tracks the most popular online video clips each week from four leading Internet TV sites. All the best video clips, on one page.

Art4Europe is an application developed during international competition Hack4Europe, which was hosted by the Europeana Fundation in association with European Commision. For the purpose of the competition the foundation made available its database containing 19 million records in a form of the API providing special data, mainly about the paintings. Application uses the abovementioned database. Art4Europe identifies paintings based on photos taken with a smartphone camera. It was the competition winner in a category of â€žsoftware of the highest commercial potentialâ€.
Store your GPS tracks in the web server and view your private and everyone public tracks on Google Maps. Supports GPX format.
Demo of an atlas system for all-in-one-page access to large geographic data sets. Application plots various types of mines throughout the US, as well as agriculture and industrial areas.

Boom cellar is a web application for investors investing in publicly traded vineyards. Boom Cellar lists all the publicly listed vineyards into one easy to use analytics tool. This application uses the HighStock API service.
Allows you to create mosaics of photos from Flickr. Each mosaic is one large image composed of small tile images.
The Charlottetown Transit Map is a PHP and JavaScript application that uses Google Maps to display up-to-the-minute information about the buses in Charlottetown. From Peter Rukavina.
LookWho helps you meet new people in real places. Instantly learn who is in the same room or event.

SakMap is the Swiss army knife of Maps. It has a built in local services search with data available for each US city the ArcGIS geocoder identifies such as weather, photos, videos, imaging, news, wikipedia and more.
ChapterBoard is a web application for fraternities and sororities. Each chapter has its own private space to coordinate events, discuss topics and collect their dues.
Bilka.dk serves jobs, in-store events and location information on their stores. Bilka is a Danish chain of hypermarkets.
Find-a-Lawyer is a simple Android native application to find a lawyer in United States. This software uses Avvo.com's API.
1dollarthings.com combines your favorite online stores into one big dollar store bargain hunt. It stores APIs to find items under a certain price point.

One Hash CRM is the easiest and most economical software in the world with its considerably flexible and customer-friendly operation. To help our customers in long-term membership and strengthen cooperation and communication, OneHash relies on combined state-of-the-art development and direct customer knowledge.
Mashup to easily share your Flickr photos on Twitter.

This Netvibes module searches for audio, video, photo or document files from your Orb account matching a search string. Clicking on results can play corresponding video or audio stream, open picture in a new window or download the document.
Facebook application for searching, rating, reviewing, and sharing summer camps. Put your favorite camps on the map and meet other friends who share the same experiences.
UK interactive guide of pubs that serve real ale. Features reviews, visits, photos, and a forum.
Browse Amazon Catalog for Movies, Books, Music, Electronic gadgets and more! By using affiliate account, you can get paid too!
MauritiusVisit.com allows you to see aerial views, photos and videos of some of the most interesting sites such as hotels, beaches and attractions in the tropical island of Mauritius.
Shows the 20 cities most vulnerable to an earthquake and the possible number of deaths that may result.
Realtime interactive LaTeX equation editor in a widget format.
Jabify is a social application that lets users to meet others from around the world. This mashup uses the Telegram Bot API.

Social Interest is a system for connecting families with a range of publicly funded health and human service programs in California. Communities can use it to screen people for programs such as Medi-Cal, Healthy Families, local health insurance programs.
Locations of most recent posters to the Twitter social networking site
Google Maps mashup of the Detroit Tigers players and where they are from. Popups include photos and links to detailed stats.

Created to help solve the 'late night' and traveler problems, this service helps you find a cab in whatever situation you're in. Just dial the number and you're instantly in touch with every cab company in the city!

SpotHero is a free website and app (iOS & Android) that helps drivers search for and reserve discounted parking in major cities such as Chicago, NYC, D.C., Boston, and others. Users can search by address and compare the nearby parking options. Once selected they can then reserved their spot.
Foamee helps track who you owe beers or coffees to, and vice versa.

Real-time geographic visualization for emerging Twitter trends. By analyzing over 5 million tweets per day to visualize trending topics on a global, regional and city level, it identifying news as it happens and tracking its impact around the world.
Emory law events provides a way for Emory law students to stay informed about events sponsored by the school.
RideDog aims to help cyclists find and map the best road rides, mountain bike trails and cyclocross rides. Useful for discovering new routes in your own communities or while traveling.
iPhoneRevu is a map and list view of Yelp Reviews formated for the iPhone. iPhoneRevu is a Yelp front-end for the iPhone.
Mashup of Joomla!, Amazon and Internet Video Archive.
A online store mashup with Flex user interface and built using Amazon AWS and EC2.
Plan, share, and discover new walking routes.
Uses the Twitter API to download and analyze US Polticians' twitter data. Uses jQuery libraries to create on-demand word clouds for parties and politicians.
View the map and find information about countries, states, and cities with one mouse click.

Gridmarker.com is a free place to store, share, view, and search for your favorite locations in Second Life. You can also find new places to explore by viewing and searching favorite locations of other users.

The GET DigitalHealth mashup enables a clinical trial sponsor, clinical research organization or an academic researcher/investigators to set up a study, select wearables/devices and start receiving data from study participants. Participants have to click on an invite link, sign the consent, and provide authorization for the device data to be accessed by Get DigitalHealth. The platform provides study teams the ability to export data to a spreadsheet, visualize or directly push data to clinical trial management systems such as the Medidata and OpenClinical. The mashup features insightful analytics, HIPAA compliant security, normalized, intelligent data retrieval, intergration with EHR and CTMS, and more.

Tutrme.com is a free global tutor database helping connect local tutors with students. The graphical map-based directory interface helps students to not have to hunt through loads of useless information in their search for a local, qualified tutor.
Global site for Geek Breakfast. Uses Facebook as primary user authentication system

Voyager Accountable Messaging allows developers to create intelligent, location-based applications for iPhone, Android, BlackBerry and most consumer electronic devices. Provides a universal set of APIs including Twilio and Twilio SMS.
Search stores for earbud headphones. Easy color based search feature.
Tastebuds is a dating service that uses the Last.fm API to match single people based on their music tastes.

hipfone.me allows hearing impaired users to recieve telephone calls from anybody in the world. It asynchronously converts a callers voice into text and sends it to the user's chatbox. The user responds with their keyboard and the message is converted into voice and played for the caller.
Watch Twitter updates in Second Life with this Twitter Fountain. Sit by the fountain of real-time tweets and watch them bubble up. This YouTube video gives you the quick demo.

Downloads entries from the Flickr public photos Atom feed every 2 hours and caches them in Amazon DynamoDB (zaps atoms into Dynamo). Why? So you can do zappy fast searches and likes of photos using DynamoDB, the premier fully managed NoSQL database service on the cloud today.
MapLib.net is a free service that allows users to upload pictures that may be as large as 6000 by 6000 and create their own custom Google maps.

Display your Etsy profile, shop or listings in a signature banner image which you can use in forums, emails, websites, blogs, etc.. This dynamic signature will update automatically if you change your profile, shop info or if you add new items to your shop.
Good way to visualize trends via the NY Times by comparing two keywords for number of article mentions over time.
Connect your YouTube video to the placeg where you recorded it. Show the world where you have been.
Multiple maps of data for New York City from government sources.
Buoy Alarm is an easy way to predict, observe and record ocean conditions. Provide ocean enthusiasts with the information they need to act with confidence.
Uses vk.com (vkontakte.ru), soundcloud.com, ex.fm, last.fm and youtube.com to give you music player and social app.
Manage and share your favorite action-driven and nature-aware spots on a Google Map and explore those of your Facebook friends.

Picbi is a way to explore Instagram on the web from a different user interface. Using the web app, users may browse through users, tags and places and create and share collections of your favorite Instagram accounts.
Find the best petrol prices in Ireland via this interactive Google Map.
Fitness facility locator that shows gyms, athletic clubs, pilates studios, and other similar places on a Google Map.
Did you know that 64% of the readers of Dan Brown's latest novel are male. Bookhu, the Gender Compatibility Engine for books, helps you find suitable books based on your gender.

YouSendPhotos.com provides online Digital Photo Print Services to Indian community all over the world to share their joys with their family members at cheaper rates. You just need to logon to your Facebook or even you can upload your pictures to yousendphotos.com website and then select your great pictures. Thats it, YouSendPhotos.com pick them from there, print in required format and Send Photo Prints to Your Home In India earlist possible. Yes, now with YouSendPhotos.com you can Send Quality Photos to India very easily from anyware and everywhere with affordable prices.
Search patent families using the open patent services API fo the European Patent Office.
Lost your phone? Canâ€™t use it at work? TXT by E is the easiest way to make your connection via SMS! Send from this website, or send using the TXT by Email feature.
See the Forbes Magazine list of the Drunkest Cities in America mapped.
Mapping community site that lets users create and save maps consisting of waypoints and routes.
The Podcast over the Phone mashup allows you to Call a phone number, and listen to Mr Brownâ€™s podcast over the phone.
Browse the vineyards of Oregon via this comprehensive map. Search by location, varietal or vineyard amenity.
Typographic news explorer using a doodled line as an interface.
Mashup of EVDB event data and Google Maps, with nice calendar browser for paging through search results.
MindMeister is a mindmapping application for the iPhone, and this mashup allows users to save their mind maps directly from MindMeister to their Box.net accounts.
Find wild creatures for EA Spore using this Google gadget for asset search views.
GeoGuessr is an exciting way to explore the world using Google Maps to guess what area you are looking at. Take a look at the picture and make your best guess, it is harder than it looks.
Simple Amazon search interface that filters items to show only things eligible for Amazon Prime free shipping.
Dirt-simple in-browser conference calls. Start a call, invite others, and begin talking.
Select any section of a webpage in Firefox and find related scientific and research papers. A resource for any scientist, literary writer or researcher in any field.
SendShorty is a Short Message Service (SMS) for business. Uses Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.

Website Authority Checker is a tool that can retrieve a website's Moz Domain Authority, Moz Page Authority, Google PageRank, approximate age, and external equity links. Domain and page authority are calculated base on metrics like the number of linking root domains, the quality of incoming links, and so on. Website Authority Checker calculates website age instead of domain age, because it's the metric more relevant to SEO.
Map of the tastest growing American states as being reported by Fortune magazine.
View the club teams for players on each of the national team rosters in this summers tournament.

Salsa's is a web application that lets customers place online orders for Mexican food in Australia. The application uses the MYOB AccountRight Live API which aenables the company to manage their inventory and customers' orders.
Slurlmarker uses your del.icio.us account to create a bookmark slurl of your favorite locations in Second Life.

Time travel through Facebook with FB Time Machine. This mashup uses Facebook, Facebook Graph and the Google App Engine and lets you view all of your friends' status updates and posted links (ever). Results are displayed on one page.
Having trouble finding new tracks to listen to on SoundCloud? Just choose a genre (or choose All Genres) and RandomCloud will play songs randomly.

Enterprise Rideshare specializes in providing customized vanpool programs and commuter services for individuals and companies across the country. Enterprise Rideshare, a Division of Enterprise Rent-A-Car, was founded in 1994 and has become a national leader in servicing both individual vanpool groups and large employer work sites. The enterpriserideshare.com is a online platform for the Rideshare program. enterpriserideshare.com provides the unified view of the rideshare offering from Enterprise. enterpriserideshare.com enables to customer to search and apply for a vanpool from any given location within the US. enterpriserideshare.com also offers the seamless ability to signup and complete the agreement formalities via an online process.
Youtube fast search has a search and video play function on one interactive page. With drag & drop features, and playlist creation.

Get to know any British Member of Parliament. Select by location, postcode or name. Traversing the UK map provides a constituency grid and instant feedback of its local MP. Extra information provides anecdotal quotes and wiki entries for the local area.
CodexMap lets you find, and place, books graphically on a map. Whether the book was added to the system by our harvester, or by you or another user, you can interact with a map to find books.

EmbeddedAnalytics enables Google Analytics reports to be embedded into web pages for the world to see. No programming knowledge is required. Embed the reports into blogs, websites, mobile websites, and anywhere an iframe tag is supported.
Forums connected to a map. Mark a place and then type a question. In other words create an initiation for a discussion and get a unique link for the map.

The Vault archives Etsy's front page features for sellers and shoppers to browse and reference. Features include live copies of each list, a configurable blog widget and screen shots of each collection.

You are at a scenic overlook and see distant summits. Find out what they are with HeyWhatsThat which provides panoramic sketches and the names of peaks. Browse panoramas that others have requested and generate your own.

Great mashup: video of racing through Paris in one window while course is drawn realtime on a map in another. In 1978 filmmaker Claude Lelouch put a gyro-stabilized camera on a Ferrari 275 GTB with a professional Formula 1 racer drive at breakneck speed.
Find out which of your Twitter friends know each other.
A real-time Twitter search tool designed to help users surface useful information from the Twittersphere.
Ranks words for happiness or sadness using the amount of twitts with happy or sad smileys for each one.
Bring online services to people without mobile Internet acces. Using a simple text message, people can use Facebook, Twitter, Viadeo and more.
This mashup combines great motorcycling routes on a map along with route information, trip length, and locations of nearest H-D dealerships and Best Western Hotels.
What's better, the book or the movie? The answer to an age old debate, using science.
This mashup allows Box.net users to load spreadsheet files directly from their Box accounts into EditGrid, where they can be viewed and edited, then saved back to a Box account.
Watch videos while you post to your friends on Twitter.
Travel site for people who do not always follow the crowds. Combines directions with points of interest.

The Road Kill Map mashup is a visual representation of the 1.24 million death that occur every year on roadways across the world. Aggressively styled on Google Maps, this mashup is a visual masterpiece.
Draws Notices to Airmen and Temporary Flight Restrictions using Google Map API
New York Subway and Bus Maps with point to point directions. Useful and well designed.

Palmoto Bee is an application that injects Google Drive forms into any Web page using CORS (Cross Domain Scripting). The form and accompanying tools can be used to capture data from the host Web page such as text, HTML, image URLs, document metadata, etc. When submitted, the data is collected and stored on Google Drive along with your other documents. It is a useful tool for doing research such as academic referencing, Web page analysis, searching for a new job, or looking for a best buy - the application can help you capture the interesting bits when and as you find them on the Web.
Twitter realtime feed. iGoogle style drag and drop with Twitter power search. Search current daily and weekly trends. Search TwitPics and audio.
View service centers in both directions on Highway 401 between Montreal and Toronto. Tourist stops near Highway 401 are included, as well as traffic cameras for Toronto and Montreal.
Flash-based interface for searching for Flickr photos and YouTube videos by tag. Initially created by Ted Patrick for an Adobe Flex demo at Mashup University.

TaggedBack.com is a free service where you register and then catalog your belongings. It allows for a simple way to keep track of the things that you own. If you lose an item that you have tagged, the person who finds it will see the tag, prompting them to go to the TaggeBack.com website. Upon entering your tag number, they will be able to notify you immediately via email and text message if you verified your phone number. The person who found your item never sees your email address unless you choose to reply to them.

A comprehensive guide for coastal activities using Google Maps and Facebook. Whether you are looking for a beach holiday, a day at the coast, a coastal path walk, tourist attractions or energetic sports activities, this site has the details.
Creative on-demand print service that lets you turn your Flickr photos from virtual content into physical content like all new Mini Cards.
Free real estate search site using Google Maps, Streetview and Bing's Bird's eye view. Shows properties in Argentina, Spain and Uruguay.
Quintura.com is a visual-based search engine for web discovery and browsing of any web content, including tests, images, videos, and products.
Video surveillance system allowing you to monitor and broadcast images of your home or office to the Internet or a mobile phone.
A free frequent-flyer mileage and point tracking site on the internet focused solely on tracking and managing rewards. Tools and services to make managing and redeeming miles and points easier.
itDuzzit enables developers and non-developers alike to build Twilio-powered voice and SMS applications without coding.
Get notified by SMS when someone fills in your Wordpress online contact form. Also works with Contact Form 7.
Places 1,909,615 Cell Towers and Antennas onto Google Maps to determine cell reception in an area.
A site is designed to help anyone thirsty for a proper pint to sort through the many pubs and night-spots of Dublin. Expansive, up-to-date database.
Online wage library for H1B prevailing wage determinations, and the disclosure data from the Department of Labor. It also integrates with indeed API to let you customize your job search.

SportShadow gives you check-in info for sports events. You can see who was at the game, read trends for different sports, even compare teams in the same sport. We follow where fans check-in so you can follow them, too. Come back often for fresh data and trends!
Play free online flash games; sports, physics, dress up, puzzle, action, arcade, multiplayer, shooting, girl, strategy games and more. Gametator.com also produces its own exclusive games.
This mashup is an example use of the Infoconnect API with a call center type application.

My Del.icio.us Recommendation Snippet is a recommendation link list generator extracted from site owners bookmarks archived in del.icio.us. If you tell your del.icio.us ID to the site, you can get the site owner's bookmarks as a recommendation.
Bestseller list for Germany's Amazon.de.

Microsoft partnership that collects offers from various providers around the Web. Bing Deals brings visitors deals from 8coupons which aggregates deals from Restaurant.com, Yelp, LivingSocial and GiltCity, among many others.
A Google Gadget for website builders. Internet and Web terms, facts, history, events, and knowledge plus everyday tips and advice for building a website, blog or e-commerce site.
PhoneTacToe uses the Twilio, Twilio SMS and Heroku APIs and allows you to play a quick game of tic-tac-toe with a friend on your phone.

Rest Area Near Me is a web application that provides users with a map of US rest areas with description and facilities list on every location. Users can see their position on the map, and check how far each rest stop is.
Keep Track of My Games aims to be a way for you to not only manage your collection of games, but also remind and track your upcoming games. Based on the Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.
Weather forecasts for South Africa.
A community mashup where parents can create, review, tag, and map fun places to take their family.

Web widgets that display Amazon items and earn referral revenue through Amazon Associates. Browser is an Amazon mini browser. List displays wish lists, baby and wedding registries, List Mania lists. Latest and Greatest shows bestsellers and new releases.
Google Maps mashup showing the worldwide coverage zones of Uber, Taxicab, Lyft, Juno, Via, Waze, Gett, and Carmel
This is a mash-up of Google Calendar, Google Maps with our church management software that tracks church events and locations of small groups that are meeting.
A user-generated, anonymous salary comparison website. Integrates with Google Maps.
A user makes a call from their phone to Platd. They say the number of a car's license plate and then record a message for that driver.
Sales Tracker is a product built around organizations who want their field sales team to report there daily sales via SMS.

The personal digital assistant is an auto attendant that filters calls. It filters calls based on a blocklist, time of day, personal contact list, and close friends identification. It harshly handles blocklist violators, and asks companies and political orgs to place your number on their do not call list.
Batch Geocoder allows you to enter multiple addresses and output them into an Address, Latitude, Longitude format.
Skypicker is a European low-cost airline ticker search engine that displays results on Google Maps. The tool has several search filters that make finding the right flight easy.
Another Tweet On The Wall is a free Twitter Wall allowing you to display tweets filtered on your keywords in a funny way.
TweetaCelebe lists all the verified celebrities and personalities on Twitter and allows users to track their tweet streams and follow them.
Displays satellite images of all 2010 Formula One Grand Prix Circuits with race results and grand prix information.
Real estate portal of luxury homes and condos in the San Francisco Bay Area. It shows $2.9 million+ properties and updated daily with new listings.
smugmug photos overlaid on top of Google Maps.
A new way of discovering music artist and albums by reading tumblr reviews about them and browsing recomendations.
Map of the home towns of US female casualties of the Iraq War.
Plots the location of over 130 zoos, safari parks, butterfly farms and other wildlife attractions throughout the UK.

A tour and attractions company that has integrated the Rezgo XML API for bookings. The product display and availability pages use the API to pull live updated product data and availability for specific tours and activities.
Whenever you check in with Foursquare and you're near a transit stop, 4sqtransit will send back a text message with realtime schedule information for that location.
Send SMS notifications to subscribers when you publish a new post on your Wordpress-powered website. Currently in Beta testing.
Displays the entire Athens transit system along with estimated arrival times and a trip planner.
Good mashup that plots fun and entertaining quotes from Overheard in New York on a Google Map.

Visual Traceroute is a web application that enables users to trace the path packets take through the Internet, by entering the URL. This application uses ipinfo.io API for geolocation and ISP details.

Tennis courts and tennis services in the United States organized on an interactive map. See the type and number of courts including whether they are lighted, include a backboard, have water and bathrooms available, etc.
Property site for landlords, property owners, managers, buyers, and tenants in Calgary and the surrounding area. Filter according to your preferences, such as close to a university.
Go Crowdless uses Foursquare check-ins to help you understand when 20 of the most popular attractions are least crowded and most crowded.
Displays book sales on an interactive map.
Simply text #selection to see it appearing on the web page in real time!
Price Comparison Shopping searches the Web for the best deals and prices on the items you want and then brings them to you in one location.
Free tool to measure the power and authority of a Twitter user.

hearSay lets you make recorded phone calls from an anonymous number using only your web browser. hearSay uses Twilio Client to connect the user to any US number, then emails the user a recording of the call automatically. No sign up or login required.
Simple JavaScript app to find bookmarks from del.icio.us.

NCAA Mens Basketball Championship on Google Maps. Includes locations of Winners, Losers, Venue. History of the Championship games from 1939-Present. Many ways to search and sort including year, highest or lowest Score, nail biters, and widest margin.
Localmouth aggregates local information for places in the UK. It provides events, property, jobs, news and other listings relevant to a given village, town or suburb.
The BigOven Cookbook is a fast and simple way to gather and publish family or group recipe collections, including those that may be spread across multiple users around the world.
Produces graphs of how often things are mentioned on guardian.co.uk.

Ask AMEE is an experiment that makes finding things easier. Instead of giving you a list of possible methodologies that might be relevant, it gives you an answer straight away. You can put in queries like â€œ10kg of coalâ€œ, and it will go off and see if AMEE has an answer. If it does, itâ€™ll give you it straight away, and give you links to find out more if you want to.

Event Now! shows Victoria, Australia events using a handy timemap, it also integrates with Google Calendar to let you save your events, invite friends and set sms reminders. Entrant in the App My State government mashup contest.
PriceCanopy is an automated repricing solution for sellers on Amazon.com. Combines competitive information from Amazon MWS and retailers' custom pricing rules to set optimal prices on listings.
Real estate, foreclosure, school performance, demographic and employment heat maps for Alpharetta, Georgia.

Helps you find accommodations, events, activities, and things to do when planning a vacation or outing in Washington State. Locations and details of each activity are superimposed on a Virtual Earth map.

Browse through list of all the rivers of the world categorized by continent, country. The rivers coordinates are mapped in Google maps, along with photos got from flickr. Provision is given to visit the details about the river in Wikipedia from the Map.
MapMate is a new way to update your Facebook status. You can plot your current location and set your status anywhere using Virtual Earth.

Fireflies is a web application that allows travelers to search for various traveling options and destinations domestically and internationally. The Allmyles API service has been integrated with this application.
A worldwide directory of fruit trees, edible plants, and other community food resources.

Share an online video link via SMS message with Mod9. Recipients can listen to the audio portion of the video by either dialing the number that sent the message or replying to the message in order to receive a call back.

Elsy Arres Flights is a web application that lets users search for upcoming flights by providing their departure location, and their destination. This application uses the Elsy Arres Flights API service.
The prototypical mashup: Google Maps + Craigslist to create a visual housing search page via dynamic overlays of Craigslist home listings on Google Maps.
Heat map of solar power in California from 1999 to 2011. Year selector that allows you to see the change in solar from year to year. Updated from our 2008 version.
Post and share events for free. Get local event information on your cell phone. Post and share invites. Uses the Eventful API.
TapGuest is a digital waitlist application for iPad and mobile phones that uses Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.
PaperShip is an app that allows users to annotate & share documents. The app syncs with a user's Mendeley and Zotero accounts. The app is available on the Mac Store for iPad, iPhone, and Mac Desktop.

Installable software (currently private beta) to help you learn more about your community thanks to different search criteria and filters that can be applied to your followers and friends. SocialBro's technology allows you to download all your community to your PC and browse them even if you are offline. SocialBro will be available as an Adobe Air desktop application and as a Google Chrome App.
Blizzalert makes it so you never a miss a great day on the mountain. You select which ski areas you want to watch and Blizzalert will send text message alerts when storms are coming through.

IronBox is a service that protects data and secures privacy. Their IronBox Express is a web app that secures a user's DropBox account, ensuring file protection for all folder contents. IronBox enables privacy protected file sharing accompanied with notifications upon content usage. IronBox Express also offers customizable themes to match a company's branding.
KivaAlerts.com is an alerts application built on the Kiva.org API to let you know when loans of your interest appear on Kiva.org.

Explore little doodles by zooming and panning with the Google Maps interface. These tiny drawings become an amazing landscape when you see them up so close - you can see the marks from each pen stroke and even see the fibers in the paper.
Generates a feed of new and upcoming music releases from the artists you scrobble on Last.fm.
Google Maps mashup helps you find where the hippest hangouts are in Williamsburg Brooklyn.
Kinoma Play is a social media browser for smartphones, and this mashup allows Box.net users to access their accounts from within Kinoma.
A realtime map of Northern Lights locations and photos. See the current aurora forecast and latest Flickr and Twitter posts related to the Aurora Borealis.
Track news coverage about anything and view trends on a chart. Combines the Daylife and Trendrr APIs.
Watch sexy Paris Hilton videos collected from YouTube.
Thank to the vzaar API users can upload and share their favourite videos.

Worldsaurus.com is a worldwide travel guide to help adventurous budget-travelers, backpackers, photographers, and vacationers plan their trips. Find the most popular places in the world, with detailed information.

Calculate your geoposition by address and create geotags, geo-metatags and kml files for your website, weblog or photo. Use a drag-and-drop marker on the result map to optimize your position. NEW: Reverse lookup - Enter a geocoded URL, see its location.
Uses Yahoo BBAuth API to let you use your Yahoo account as an OpenID.

Check any national or international flights via your mobile. Send in a flights tail number i.e. NZ1 to YouTXTs 8808 shortcode and check for a flights real-time arrival, departure and delay information.
Wiki and mapping site allowing scuba divers to share their favorite dive sites and advice. Good interface.

The Inside Big Data Mashup processes and filters high volumes of data from a variety of sources in the web. The mashup identifies data sources, such as news and blogs, in addition to summarizing the breakdown of metadata associated to the sources. This way, users can access important descriptive data such as dates, visitor counts, and comments attributable to particular sources of data.

This is an application that allows you send SMS within the US using your Android phone via cloud service provided by Twilio. Saves money for people who don't use SMS often; pay only 2c per message when you use Twilio to send or receive SMS. The current version also provides you a way to receive SMS sent to your Twilio number via email.
